description.value: Tent-only camping stretched along 2 km of pebble beach on Harrison Lake, with 6 forested walk-in sites and the rest directly on the shore — no potable water, no garbage service, pit toilets only, and a forest-service road shared with logging trucks.

address.value: Harrison East Forest Service Rd, Fraser Valley, BC V0M 1K0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content from harrisoneastcamping.com/cogburn-beach/ is fully accessible and provides detailed information about Cogburn Beach. The FAQ and Know Before You Go pages explicitly confirm no potable water, showers, power, or garbage service, allowing false values for those amenities. The Reservations subpage confirms an online reservation system is active, supporting value=true for reservations accepted.
concerns: Site is cash only — no card payment accepted, which may be a significant inconvenience for touring cyclists.
No potable water on site — cyclists must carry all water in.
No cellular service — no communication or navigation assistance available on site.
No phone number in OSM or on website; contact is email only (harrisoneast@hotmail.com).
Tents only — no RV or trailer accommodation; no trailer parking available.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, active Recreation Sites & Trails BC campsite on Harrison Lake suitable for touring cyclists seeking a rustic overnight stop, though its lack of potable water, power, and showers should be clearly noted in the listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Site is managed by Greenshades Enterprises in partnership with Recreation Sites & Trails BC. Firewood is sometimes available for sale on site but may sell out.
